LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 12.1.1 LISTENING TO RESPOND: ATTITUDE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.1: Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Attitude
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Attitude, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: What messages are found in songs? 2. What makes one like or dislike a song?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Attitude together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner gains confidence by engaging in fruitful discussions.

• Digital literacy is developed as the learner interacts with digital devices while listening to songs.

106

Values:
Respect is promoted as the learner endeavours to accommodate the opinions of their peers as they perform songs.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Effective Communication is boosted as the learner expresses his or her opinion on songs.

Link to other subjects:

Creative Arts requires learners to express their opinions on different issues.
